Selection/broadcast/use/effect remain distinct; ResourceHandle lifetime belongs at causal-use/effect lowering and receipts, not workspace authority.
Semantic/active/coordination/physical topology remain distinct; resource ownership is primarily physical/runtime topology metadata with semantic identity links.

H1/H2/H3 remain downstream of BASE; eventual differential replay must include resource lifetime and effect receipts.
